svg.title: About Me
svg.desc: I’m an advisor and builder. I previously worked on security at Dropbox and product at Instart and Google. I authored Surreptitious Software and served as tech lead for Caja. I love good food, fine wine, and great JavaScript. Zooms to the building, centres its card, then returns the island to a common overview.
